title: knitCompanion Counter Session Status Mix
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=knitcompanion:counter
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(counter_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the knitCompanion counter session feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `counter_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the overall mood of your knitCompanion counter session feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
